paragraphs: R' Nechunya of the Valley of Beit Chortan.

notes.text: נחוניא, Nechunya, and חוניא, Chunya, remain different supplied forms. The locality is בקעת בית חורתן, the Valley of Beit Chortan, with conventional vowels and no further identification. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
